title: Add Binary Strings
description: Given two non-empty binary strings `a` and `b` consisting of `'0'` and `'1'` (with no leading zeros except for `"0"` itself), return their sum as a binary string.
constraints: a and b consist only of '0' or '1' characters.
hints: Add from right to left maintaining a carry bit, just like elementary binary addition.
Continue the loop while either string has remaining digits or carry is non-zero, then reverse the result.
